title: Three-slit interference with a which-path memory ancilla: A bright-dark state formulation
summary: In this paper, we study the effect of a which-path memory ancilla on the three-slit interference pattern within the framework of the bright--dark state description [Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 133603 (2025)]. Whereas two slits give one bright mode, a photonic mode that couples to the detector atoms, and one dark mode, which does not couple to the detector atoms, three slits lead to one detector-coupled bright mode and a two-dimensional dark-mode subspace in the three-dimensional path space.
